990010101.des:
1. Once the quiz begins, 15 multiple-choice questions will appear.
2. You will have 30 seconds to answer each question.
3. After answering all questions, the system will distribute rewards based on your result and time spent.
4. Reach the specified target of correct answers to claim the target reward.
5. If you exit midway, the current question will be marked incorrect. Tap Continue to proceed with the remaining questions.
6. During the quiz, you can use the help function to communicate with Alliance members.
990010101.shortDes:
Wisdom Challenge, Rapid Quiz!
15 questions, the more you answer correctly, the greater the rewards!
Join forces with Alliance members for mutual success!
